notes: Modified cash basis village audit, FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total column); other financing sources (Donations, Interest income, Interest expense, TIF receipts) recorded as other_financing at their printed total 79,811.92 (printed section rule): 403,566.88 + 289,938.85 - 368,268.66 + 79,811.92 = 405,048.99. Fund balances recorded as fund balance; ending_cash = cash lines of the governmental funds statement (p3), certificates of deposit as investments; no beginning cash printed. Business-type from the proprietary fund statement (p6, modified cash, Total column; Water, Sewer, Garbage), roll-forward of net position 356,981.37 + 239,014.80 - 198,122.01 = 397,874.16. proprietary null (modified cash basis, as FY2023/FY2024). Detail: General Fund from the combining departments schedule (pp10-11, rotated pages, one line per department column; nonoperating TIF/donations/interest below the operating result marked outside_printed_total; the nonoperating interest cells add to 357 against a printed 356); the all-funds budget schedule (p9) supplies the Street, Keno, PCI, Water, Sewer and Garbage expenditure lines only (its revenues are all-funds combined and its General Fund lines are superseded by the departments schedule). Department functions: Cemetery health/welfare; Park, Library, Museum culture/recreation (budget schedule p9 prints 'Culture and Recreation - park/library/museum'); Visitor Center, Youth Center and Community Hall have no printed function, so general government (the Statement of Activities counts the General Fund departments in General Government, p2); TIF Projects debt service.
